plugins.name: t7kb
plugins.description: Local Black Ops 3 modding knowledge base — hybrid (keyword + semantic) search over the BO3 modding community, served to the agent over MCP, plus grounded skills for scripting, debugging, mapping, building/compiling, assets/porting, animation, cross-generation animation retargeting, zombies AI, HUD/Lua, particle FX, atmosphere, and cross-referencing other Call of Duty titles. Run /t7kb:setup once to install; /t7kb:contribute is the guide for writing new skills.
